Title: LSJ: "Take control" - Shepherd's Innocence and Chameleon

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
My Google-fu is failing me.

If I play inferior Shepherd's Innocence, can I "take control" of a card
I control? For example, to move it around from a vampire who got the
card early on to a vampire who can make use of it now.

Ditto, can I therefore use Chameleon as a way of making a titled vampire
an anarch - assuming, of course, I brought out in my last influence
phase (or during this minion phase with Undue Influence, I guess).

This also looks like it would be possible with New Management, to cycle
it perhaps.

Many other cards that say "take control" specify that the target is
controlled by someone else. The main card I can find that does allow
you to do this is using a Temptation on yourself - untap yourself and
take control when you have enough counters.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/b873b0fab3c4a7c6

I'm reasonably sure that would work with these cards, but a couple of us
were discussing this on #vtes and weren't entirely sure.

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
> My Google-fu is failing me.
>
> If I play inferior Shepherd's Innocence, can I "take control" of a card
> I control? For example, to move it around from a vampire who got the
> card early on to a vampire who can make use of it now.

I'd say 'no' to the moving around/retargetting in general, based on
Disputed Territory.

Only equipment and retainers can be rearranged, and that's because of
explicit card text.

> Ditto, can I therefore use Chameleon as a way of making a titled vampire
> an anarch - assuming, of course, I brought out in my last influence
> phase (or during this minion phase with Undue Influence, I guess).

This sounds reasonable, however.

> This also looks like it would be possible with New Management, to cycle
> it perhaps.

Sure, take control of it, but no retargetting. Again, Disputed Territory
as precedent.

> Many other cards that say "take control" specify that the target is
> controlled by someone else. The main card I can find that does allow
> you to do this is using a Temptation on yourself - untap yourself and
> take control when you have enough counters.
>
> http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/b873b0fab3c4a7c6
>
> I'm reasonably sure that would work with these cards, but a couple of us
> were discussing this on #vtes and weren't entirely sure.

Sure, take control of things you already control. But you won't get to
retarget unless specific card text allows it (or unless the control is
given to the *minion* taking the effect, rather than 'you').
